name: we-bribed-everyone
why: Opens on "We stopped having wars four thousand two hundred and ninety-seven years ago. Not because we evolved morally. We bribed everyone."; the factory follows the money into a lab, Earth rides its weapons chart to the top, and the BEST ROCK-HITTERS rosette ends up on its headstone (about 61 s).

name: paying-the-arsonist
why: "Climate change: solved the moment everyone realized they'd personally be alive to see the consequences", then YOU pays the oil derrick to burn his own beach house and gets set on fire himself (about 47 s).

name: a-better-app
why: "Lobbyists were an invasive species that had evolved to feed exclusively on politicians"; the tick falls off its host, becomes a life coach, and the politicians join the dinosaurs: "The dinosaurs had an asteroid. The politicians just had a better app." (about 74 s).
